posts.body_html:
Here's another interesting clone of S. montana that I've labeled clone BB to distinguish it from genetically different clones. Unfortunately, I have no idea what county and state this clone came from, but it's from the same population as this plant: sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/274/large-clone-montana-pic-update In fact, I sometimes have a hard time telling the two apart. At some point last year, they looked exactly the same.

Nice thing is this clone grows extremely fast, and I bet it can color up in the fall just like clone AA.
